pyramiding_rule: Strict ban on adding to losing positions; secondary position scaling is permitted only when primary position stop-loss is moved to Breakeven + 1.5 ATR.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require pre-trade validation enforcing maximum risk <= $5.00 per 0.01 lot and block entries if M5 ATR exceeds 2.5x the baseline.
profit_harvest_threshold: Activate Breakeven lock at +$3.00 profit and trigger trailing stop algorithm aiming for a minimum 1:3 R:R reward ($15.00+).
